verdict.rationale: Raygun documents some per-application trend analysis. Deployment tracking surfaces new errors and regressions per release (raygun-docs-31). Errors can be ranked by occurrences and users affected and filtered by version and date (raygun-docs-3). An error chart on the search results page shows frequency and trends over time (raygun-docs-19), and a Crash Reporting dashboard exists (raygun-docs-9). However, nothing shows leader-level dashboards that roll up trends across multiple projects or teams. missing for 10: cross-project/team aggregated dashboards, an explicit 'top regressions' view, configurable leadership dashboards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
